theorems.name: SMCFHR.clip01_nonneg
theorems.formal_statement: 0 <= clip01 x
theorems.limitations: Exact over R; Python execution uses IEEE-754 floating-point arithmetic.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.clip01_le_one
theorems.formal_statement: clip01 x <= 1
theorems.limitations: Exact over R; Python execution uses IEEE-754 floating-point arithmetic.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.clip01_mono
theorems.formal_statement: x <= y -> clip01 x <= clip01 y
theorems.limitations: Exact over R.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.huber_nonneg
theorems.formal_statement: 0 <= huber delta r
theorems.limitations: Requires delta > 0.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.psi_abs_le
theorems.formal_statement: |psi delta r| <= delta
theorems.limitations: Requires delta > 0.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.psi_lipschitz
theorems.formal_statement: |psi delta r1 - psi delta r2| <= |r1 - r2|
theorems.limitations: Requires delta > 0.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.hasDerivAt_huber
theorems.formal_statement: HasDerivAt (huber delta) (psi delta r) r
theorems.limitations: First derivative is C^1; second derivative is not everywhere continuous at |r| = delta.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.convexOn_huber
theorems.formal_statement: ConvexOn Real Set.univ (huber delta)
theorems.limitations: Convexity is global; strict convexity holds only on [-delta, delta] (interior (-delta, delta)).

theorems.name: SMCFHR.strictConvexOn_huber_band
theorems.formal_statement: StrictConvexOn Real (Set.Ioo (-delta) delta) (huber delta)
theorems.limitations: Strict convexity is restricted to the open band (-delta, delta).

theorems.name: SMCFHR.convex_feasibleSet
theorems.formal_statement: Convex Real (FeasibleSet M)
theorems.limitations: Exact on Params p = R x (Fin p -> R).

theorems.name: SMCFHR.isClosed_feasibleSet
theorems.formal_statement: IsClosed (FeasibleSet M)
theorems.limitations: Exact on Params p.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.convexOn_objective
theorems.formal_statement: ConvexOn Real Set.univ (objective delta Z y alpha)
theorems.limitations: Requires alpha_j >= 0 for all j.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.hasDerivAt_objective_line
theorems.formal_statement: HasDerivAt (fun t => objective delta Z y alpha (theta + t • d)) (gradB * d.1 + sum j, gradW j * d.2 j) 0
theorems.limitations: Formalizes exact analytical directional derivative; does not formalize L-BFGS-B numerical convergence.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.objective_subgradient
theorems.formal_statement: objective theta + (gradB * (theta'.1 - theta.1) + sum j, gradW j * (theta'.2 j - theta.2 j)) <= objective theta'
theorems.limitations: Requires alpha_j >= 0.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.gradB_lipschitz
theorems.formal_statement: |gradB theta1 - gradB theta2| <= (1/n) * sum k, |(theta1.1 + sum j, Z k j * theta1.2 j) - (theta2.1 + sum j, Z k j * theta2.2 j)|
theorems.limitations: Explicit Lipschitz bound for the intercept gradient component.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.gradB_term_bound
theorems.formal_statement: |((1/n) * (-psi delta (resid Z y theta k)))| <= delta / n
theorems.limitations: Bounds per-observation gradient contribution in response residuals; does not imply bounded influence under arbitrary leverage in Z.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.gradW_term_bound
theorems.formal_statement: |((1/n) * (-Z k j * psi delta (resid Z y theta k)))| <= |Z k j| * delta / n
theorems.limitations: Explicitly displays linear dependence on |Z k j| (no bounded influence for unbounded covariates Z).

theorems.name: SMCFHR.objective_coercive
theorems.formal_statement: exists R > 0, forall theta, (R < |theta.1| or exists j, R < |theta.2 j|) -> C < objective delta Z y alpha theta
theorems.limitations: Requires n >= 1 and strictly positive alpha_j > 0 for all j.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.exists_global_minimizer
theorems.formal_statement: exists theta_star in FeasibleSet M, IsMinOn (objective delta Z y alpha) (FeasibleSet M) theta_star
theorems.limitations: Requires n >= 1 and strictly positive alpha_j > 0.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.unique_weights
theorems.formal_statement: IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet M) theta1 -> IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet M) theta2 -> theta1.2 = theta2.2
theorems.limitations: Proves uniqueness of weight vector w*, not of the intercept b*.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.unique_intercept_of_interior_residual
theorems.formal_statement: IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet M) theta1 -> IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet M) theta2 -> (exists k0, |resid Z y theta1 k0| < delta) -> theta1.1 = theta2.1
hypotheses: exists k0, |resid Z y theta1 k0| < delta
theorems.limitations: Sufficient condition; without an interior residual, b* need not be unique.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.intercept_nonunique_counterexample
theorems.formal_statement: theta1 != theta2 and objective theta1 = (3/2)*delta^2 and objective theta2 = (3/2)*delta^2 and IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet empty) theta1 and IsMinOn J (FeasibleSet empty) theta2
theorems.limitations: Explicit counterexample with n=2, p=1, Z=0, y=(-2*delta, 2*delta).

theorems.name: SMCFHR.kkt_iff_isMinOn
theorems.formal_statement: IsMinOn (objective delta Z y alpha) (FeasibleSet M) theta <-> (gradB = 0 and (forall j not in M, gradW j = 0) and (forall j in M, 0 <= gradW j and theta.2 j * gradW j = 0))
theorems.limitations: Exact necessity and sufficiency over FeasibleSet M.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.predictCF_bounds
theorems.formal_statement: 0 <= predictCF b w z_raw x_mean x_scale y_med y_scale and predictCF b w z_raw x_mean x_scale y_med y_scale <= 1
theorems.limitations: Exact over R.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.predictEnergy_bounds
theorems.formal_statement: 0 <= predictEnergy ... and predictEnergy ... <= 24000 * cap_MW * H_dir
theorems.limitations: Exact over R.

theorems.name: SMCFHR.predictEnergy_monotone_in_restricted
theorems.formal_statement: x_raw j0 <= x_raw' j0 -> (forall j != j0, x_raw j = x_raw' j) -> predictEnergy ... x_raw <= predictEnergy ... x_raw'
hypotheses: h_eq : forall j != j0, x_raw j = x_raw' j
theorems.limitations: Holds ceteris paribus; does not assert joint monotonicity across multiple simultaneous changes.
